integrity: Analytical proof; finite numerical diagnostics supplement but do not establish infinite asymptotics. Publication priority and external validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Continuum stationary Poisson resetting with fixed positive r and lambda; not first-passage total cost. No uniformity for lambda/sqrt(r) approaching one and no finite-lattice claim. The underlying exact density and fixed-alpha finiteness threshold are prior work.
title: Singular weak-sluggishness law for exponential reset costs
